# Test Fixtures

JSON fixtures generated by the circuits crate. Consumed by Foundry tests and the deploy script via `vm.readFile`.

## Files

### `asset_registry.json`
Asset registry. Maps asset IDs to ERC20 token labels and scales used for value commitments. Asset generators are derived in-circuit via `HashToAssetGen(publicAssetId)` and not stored on-chain.

- `ids` — asset identifiers
- `scales` — per-asset scaling factors
- `names` / `symbols` / `decimals` — ERC20 metadata for the mock token deployments

Used by [DeployTest.s.sol](../../script/DeployTest.s.sol) and [MASP.deploy.t.sol](../MASP.deploy.t.sol) to seed the deployed MASP.

### `proof_deposit.json`
Single deposit proof sample for MASP integration tests.

- `chainId`, `assetId` — context for the proof
- `publicIn` / `publicOut` — public deposit/withdraw amounts
- `recipient` — destination address
- `merkleRoot` — commitment tree root the proof was generated against (matches the empty root in `tree.json`)
- `proof` — Groth16 proof (`a`, `b`, `c`)

Used by [MASP.t.sol](../MASP.t.sol) to verify end-to-end deposit flow against the on-chain verifier.

### `tree.json`
Commitment tree test vectors for the incremental Merkle tree implementation.

- `depth` — tree depth
- `emptyRoot` — root of empty tree at given depth
- `cases[]` — list of `{ leaves, root }` pairs, each giving the expected root after inserting the listed leaves in order

Used by [CommitmentTree.t.sol](../CommitmentTree.t.sol) to cross-check Solidity tree against the circuit reference.

## Regeneration

Fixtures produced by the circuits crate at `../../circuits`. Re-run its fixture export task after changing hash params, depth, or generator set.
